_comment: Screenpipe runtime settings this experiment depends on, checked by scripts/preflight-capture.sh. Captured from ~/.screenpipe/store.bin. Secrets redacted - set those in the Screenpipe UI, not here.
_why_this_engine: Measured under continuous two-stream speech on the 16GB box: whisper-large-v3-turbo-quantized fell behind without bound (lag 5s -> 157s in 210s); whisper-tiny recovered but peaked at 38s; whisper-tiny-quantized at 5s chunks ran at 2-6s steady state (median 8.0s, p90 18.1s including warm-up bursts). Accuracy matters little here: live turn durations come from voiced segments, not words.
_auto_update_note: autoUpdate is NOT asserted: screenpipe's remote control policy (settings.remoteControlPolicy.autoUpdate.forceEnabled=true, pushed from the vendor) re-enables it on every launch and greys out the UI toggle. The version assertions below are the real guard: a version change fails preflight and must be treated as a GrowthBook phase boundary.
